data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Charge phase](vsdata:core-rule/charge-phase), after an enemy unit picks its **charge target**.

**Target:** A **T'AU EMPIRE GRENADES** unit of yours that is one of that charge's targets.

**Effect:** The charging unit takes a [Battle-shock test](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock) at once, and gets -2 to its [Charge rolls](vsdata:core-rule/charge-step) for the rest of the phase.

**Restrictions:** A unit in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any enemy unit cannot be targeted.
